selection: one global gamma/delta minimizing equal-weight tuning RMSE across four sensitivities
anti_windup: conditional integration; clipping alone is not treated as anti-windup
nominal_gain: median positive normalized dy/du on tuning seeds at nominal sensitivity; validation excluded
diagnostics: gain-ratio RMSE vs true sensitivity (diagnostic only)
limits: local dy/du is a heuristic, not full plant identification
g/g_nom is not assumed identical to simulator sensitivity
